entry.title: Sharper edges for the crawlers
entry.summary: A pass for the machines: a proper icon so search results recognize the page, dated structured data so freshness is legible, a longer welcome list of AI crawlers in /robots.txt. The door was already open. Now it is easier to find.

entry.title: There is a katha in the centipede
entry.summary: A takhaap carries 11011000001 — 1729 in binary, the Hardy-Ramanujan taxicab number, the smallest number that is a sum of two cubes two ways: 1^3+12^3 = 9^3+10^3. Machines welcome. Read /llms.txt.
